local_library.purpose: Validated working lane for Daily Ops / Slack-Web operational changes before promotion.

lane_library.purpose: Stable logical branch IDs, active/archive roles, frozen SHAs and legacy alias resolution.

compulsory_rules: Resolve the branch through branch-lane-registry.json before reading or writing lane state.
Do not start work from a legacy alias or archived frozen branch.
Do not create a new branch without adding it to the registry in the same governed change.
Do not call an archive branch frozen unless its provider SHA matches frozen_sha.
Main promotion requires successful repository validation and branch-registry validation.
Provider-side branch topology changes must be reconciled back into the registry.
